cristal-den/investigate-bibin.title: A thorn in her hoof
cristal-den/investigate-bibin.description: The Matriarch wants something she can use against Bibin. Get close to him, work your way into his crew, and find proof of what he's really up to.
cristal-den/investigate-bibin.desc-sneaky-job: Getting close to Bibin isn't an option anymore - his crew shoots you on sight. You'll have to find your proof another way: get into his belongings without him knowing.
cristal-den/investigate-bibin.desc-met-herd-leader: You found your proof. Bibin sent you to rescue his "friends" from a Cristal Den patrol. Turns out his friends are Golden Herd, through and through.
cristal-den/investigate-bibin.desc-found-note: You found proof, of all places, in a note among Bibin's belongings: guard shifts for one of the enforcers' outposts, with an attack plan scrawled onto it in a different hoofwriting. That outpost was the one hit by the Golden Herd.
cristal-den/investigate-bibin.desc-completed: You told the Matriarch everything. Seems like she was already expecting that news. She's preparing something big.
